$comment: StoryRail for the office squad: GitLab for stories, merge requests and CI; Sonar, Fortify and NexusIQ for quality scans. Fill in every TODO(office) value (`node scripts/storyrail-workspace.mjs todo` lists them). See docs/storyrail/SETUP.md.

gitlab.$comment: Your GitLab. Agents reach it with a personal access token (scope api) through scripts/storyrail-gitlab.mjs, or through the GitLab MCP server if it is configured in Bob. Never put the token in this file.

backlog.$comment: The GitLab project where the user stories and bugs live (with the Screen and API documents attached). Issue numbers are this project's issue IIDs.

hub.$comment: This repo (agents, dashboard, run records) on your GitLab.

apiTests.$comment: Cucumber + Java acceptance tests for the backend, run against the local backend. Part of the backend lane. Set to null if your API automation lives in the backend repo.

mergeRequests.$comment: Step 7: one MR per repo in the run. waitForMrPipeline: wait for the MR pipeline before asking you to merge. mergeOrder: the order the MRs are merged in; after each merge StoryRail waits for the pipeline on the default branch.

scans.$comment: Quality scans in steps 4 and 6. mode: local = run the command on your machine before anything is pushed; ci = push the branch, let its GitLab pipeline run the scan job, then read the result; off = skip. Commands run from the project folder; $BRANCH is the run branch. Tokens come from environment variables, never from this file.

sonar.gate: Quality gate passed and no open blocker or critical issue on new code

commands.backend: TODO(office): e.g. sourceanalyzer -b storyrail -clean && sourceanalyzer -b storyrail mvn -B -q package -DskipTests && sourceanalyzer -b storyrail -scan -f target/fortify.fpr

fortify.results: TODO(office): e.g. FPRUtility -information -search -query "[fortify priority order]:critical OR [fortify priority order]:high" -project target/fortify.fpr

commands.backend: TODO(office): e.g. java -jar $NEXUS_IQ_CLI -s $NEXUS_IQ_URL -a $NEXUS_IQ_USER:$NEXUS_IQ_TOKEN -i <backend-app-id> -t build -r nexus-iq.json target/

nexusIQ.gate: No policy violation at Critical or Severe

designSystem.$comment: The company component library the frontend must build screens from. Set enabled to true once the TODO(office) values are filled in; the rules in .bob/rules-sr-fe-dev/02-design-system.md then apply.
designSystem.package: TODO(office): npm package of the component library, e.g. @your-org/ui-components
designSystem.storybookUrl: TODO(office): URL of the Storybook that documents it

references.$comment: Existing applications the developers copy patterns from. Cloned read-only into references/ by `node scripts/storyrail-workspace.mjs sync`; no mode may edit them. Keep them on your internal GitLab, never in a public repo.

squad.$comment: The squad as shown on the dashboard. stations = the status ids each member reports on; brief = the mode's rule folder (sr-*) or 'orchestrator'; outOfScope = a person who works outside StoryRail (shown greyed, can't be asked).
